title: Teachers are catching AI in Google Docs with this trick #aidetection #googlehacks #tech
description: This video shows how to detect if AI was used to write in a Google Doc, a crucial skill for anyone dealing with ai content. We explore the edit history to spot AI-generated text and learn how to humanize ai text. This how to guide is especially useful for teacher tips to ensure academic integrity.
